description: Requires the account session, current X-Organization-Id and CSRF for writes. Set or remove the private manual expiry. It does not change the registry data or confirm renewal payment. Send manual_expires_on, dns, or both. Omitted settings are preserved. DNS requires both selectors and rotating_addresses. A manual date does not change registry data or confirm renewal payment. An identical retry is idempotent. A conflicting revision returns 409.

revision.description: Current revision from the corresponding settings or monitor. Use zero for the first change.

name: set_domain_expiry
title: Set domain expiry
